text_description: Cropped runway look shown from head to lower thigh, built around an oversized, boxy outer jacket in pale grey and off-white narrow vertical striping with a coarse woven surface. The jacket is worn open over a matching warm khaki/tan button-front inner layer; it has a high turned-up collar with dark speckled/fringed edging, dropped shoulders, wide short sleeves ending around the upper arms, and heavily frayed black-and-navy trim along the sleeve edges, front opening, hem, and patch-pocket edges. Small dark horizontal toggle-like tabs and scattered gold-tone buttons punctuate the front, while the jacket falls to about upper-thigh length and reads structured but relaxed. Underneath, a tan utility-like top or vest sits close to the torso with a V opening, gold round buttons down the center, and visible patch pockets near the lower front, extending over a coordinating tan skirt. The skirt is slim and knee-length or just above the knee in the visible crop, with a softly tailored front, a pocket where one hand is tucked, and a decorative chain-like trim along the hem edge. A slouchy tan shoulder bag with burgundy side panels is carried under the left arm, suspended from a gold chain strap over the shoulder; the bag surface appears soft and slightly crumpled. The palette is muted and earthy—grey, black, tan, khaki, burgundy, and gold accents—with a layered, textured, deconstructed-luxe mood.
